flags.why: The common weather sense meaning slightly chilly is missing.
flags.fix: adj | slightly chilly; cool — Trời se lạnh vào buổi sáng. = It is slightly chilly in the morning.

flags.why: The common adjectival meaning 'tropical' is missing.
flags.fix: adj | tropical — Việt Nam có khí hậu nhiệt đới. = Vietnam has a tropical climate.

flags.why: The example defines the word instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Trong cơm mẻ có những con mẻ rất nhỏ. = There are very tiny microworms in the fermented rice.

flags.why: Using xuôi for travelling downstream is ordinary Vietnamese, so the literary tag is misleading.
The everyday meaning referring to the Vietnamese acute tone or its written mark is missing.
flags.fix: noun | acute tone; acute accent — Chữ này thiếu dấu sắc. = This word is missing its acute accent.
